import narwhals as nw


def top_sales(df):
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    result = nw_df.filter(nw.col("amount") > 100).sort("amount", descending=True)
    return result.to_native()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pandas as pd
    import polars as pl

    # Test with pandas
    df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
        "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
        "amount": [50, 150, 200, 75, 120]
    })
    print("Pandas input:")
    print(df_pandas)
    print("\nPandas output:")
    print(top_sales(df_pandas))

    # Test with polars
    df_polars = pl.DataFrame({
        "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
        "amount": [50, 150, 200, 75, 120]
    })
    print("\n\nPolars input:")
    print(df_polars)
    print("\nPolars output:")
    print(top_sales(df_polars))
